notes_for_editor: Height conflict: register says 46 ft, 1989 USFS report says 45 ft 9 in; the story says so and does not pick one. The 1932 letter's 40-ft proposal is quoted on the West Lookouts Arizona index page, not a letter scan. Current status, access and staffing were not found; the 'inactive' wording comes from the 2001 register entry. The NRHP date is the NPGallery 'Date Published' field, matching French Wikipedia (not cited). The NRHP nomination PDF was not opened, so the builder is unconfirmed (Wikimapia credits the CCC, not used). The register says 'National Register of Historic Sites', which is a wording slip for the NRHP. The register spells the district 'Morman Lake'. Record has no height or access data to correct. Verification 2026-10-09: story said 'National Register of Historic Places' as the register's wording; the register says 'National Register of Historic Sites', so the story now says 'the National Register'. Added evidence for the 1932 letter date and the 'Nominated by' credit, both checked on the source pages.
